title: Rules and Regulations: Eligibility for an Offer of Payment Arrangements (Deferred Payment Agreements)
content:
**Cedar Fork Electric Cooperative Rules and Regulations — Payment Arrangements (Deferred Payment Agreements): eligibility for an offer**

**§1 Choosing the tier.** The tier is the one whose rate schedules include the service account's rate schedule and whose member types include the member's member type, and whose remaining entry conditions hold. Where several tiers fit, the member chooses among them.

**§2 Account status.** The service account's status must be one of the tier's account statuses in which an offer may be made, on the offer date, as the cooperative's service account record shows it.

**§3 Connected service.** An agreement may be offered only after the tier's minimum number of full calendar months have passed since the service account was connected. The months are counted from the connect date on the service account record to the same day number of the later month, falling back to the last day of that month when the day number does not exist. The offer date must be on or after the day so reached; an offer on that day itself meets this condition.

| Hypothetical connect date | Minimum months | Day reached | Offer on that day | Offer on the day before |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| March 15 | 6 | September 15 | meets §3 | does not meet §3 |
| March 31 | 6 | September 30 (September has no 31st) | meets §3 | does not meet §3 |
| any date | 0 | the connect date | meets §3 | — |

**§4 Offer season.** The offer date must fall inside the tier's offer window, from its first offer day through its last offer day.

**§5 Past-due amount.** The past-due amount must be at least the tier's smallest past-due amount, and after the down payment no more than the tier's largest arranged amount. The past-due amount is reckoned on the offer date, on the service account offered: the service account's balance, less the charges of the latest billing period whose due date (the bill date plus the bill due days of the account's rate schedule under Electric Service by Rate Schedule) has not yet passed, and less any credit balance; never below zero.

*Hypothetical:* a balance of $412.60 of which $96.40 is the latest bill, not yet due, gives a past-due amount of $316.20; once that bill's due date has passed, the whole $412.60 is past due.

**§6 Energy assistance pledge and medical protection.** Where the tier requires an energy assistance pledge, a pledge must have been recorded on the service account within the tier's pledge lookback days. Where the tier requires medical certificate protection, the medical certificate expiry date on the service account must be on or after the offer date. The open pledges on the service account are reckoned over the tier's pledge lookback days ending on the offer date: the pledges recorded on the service account in that window, less the energy assistance agency payments from the same agency posted on or after each pledge's date.

**§7 Other programs and final bills.** No tier may coexist with PrePay Power or Budget Billing, so a service account enrolled in PrePay Power (Prepaid Metering) or on an active Budget Billing (Levelized and Equal Payment Plans) plan cannot be offered an agreement, as the enrollment and plan records for that service account show; and because no tier allows a final-billed account, a final-billed balance is never arranged.

**§8 Counseling line.** Where the tier requires it, the member is given the energy assistance counseling line with the offer.

All conditions in §§2 through 7 are read from the cooperative's records before the offer is made.
